title: Airplanes landing on roads
content: I’ve seen posts about the bridges and highways that are like roller coasters. I have dreams of those things several times per week. Nearly all of my dreams for the past few years involve travel. I also have a variation in which I’m on an airplane (usually a normal commercial flight) that takes off from an airport. Shortly after, we have to make an emergency landing on a freeway, highway, or sometimes a small suburban street. We always land safely. Then, instead of stopping, the pilots decide to just drive the plane on the road as if it were a bus. They usually announce this over the plane’s speaker system, letting us know that we’ll get to the destination, but we’re going to be very late. I get mildly upset and confused, because how will the wings fit on this road? Won’t we hit overpasses or other vehicles? But there’s nothing I can do about it. So I just sigh and resign myself to the situation. Has anyone else been on the road-planes?
